title: Say times with fractions of an hour: half past, quarter past, quarter to

lesson.title: Half Past, Quarter Past, Quarter To

steps.say: You already know how to read a clock to the nearest five minutes, and you know that one whole hour is sixty minutes. Today we learn the special nicknames people say out loud for some of those times: half past, quarter past, and quarter to.

visual.caption: One whole hour is one whole trip around the clock: 60 minutes

steps.say: Think of the hour like a pizza. If we cut the whole hour into two equal pieces, each piece is one half, and one half of sixty minutes is thirty minutes. So thirty minutes past the hour is called half past.

visual.caption: Half of an hour shaded: 30 minutes

steps.say: Now cut that same hour pizza into four equal pieces instead. Each piece is one quarter, and one quarter of sixty minutes is fifteen minutes. Fifteen minutes after the hour is called quarter past, because a quarter of the hour has gone past.

visual.caption: One quarter of an hour shaded: 15 minutes

steps.say: Here is Maya on the SkyTrain in Vancouver. Her clock shows four o'clock with the long hand on the three, which you know is fifteen minutes after four. Since fifteen minutes is one quarter of the hour, we say quarter past four.

Quarter to is the tricky one. When the long hand is on the nine, the clock says four forty-five, but there are still fifteen minutes left before five o'clock. Because one quarter of an hour is still to come, we say quarter to five, not quarter to four. Sixty minus forty-five is fifteen, and that fifteen is the piece still waiting.

visual.caption: 4:45 — 15 minutes still to go, so quarter to FIVE

steps.say: So remember: half past means thirty minutes after the hour, quarter past means fifteen minutes after the hour, and quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour.

visual.caption: Half an hour is 30 minutes; a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes

lesson.answer: Half past is 30 minutes after the hour, quarter past is 15 minutes after, and quarter to is 15 minutes before the NEXT hour.

practice.question: Liam's soccer practice at the community field starts when the clock shows seven o'clock with the long hand pointing at the nine. Draw that clock if it helps. What time does the clock read in numbers, and how would you say it out loud using the words 'quarter past' or 'quarter to'?
practice.answer: The clock reads seven forty-five. Since 60 minus 45 equals 15, there are 15 minutes left until eight o'clock, so we say quarter to eight.
